description: This file defines the class 'TreeBasedPolicyAlgorithm', which implements the 'PolicyAlgorithm' interface to evaluate policies and permissions using a tree-based enforcer. It acts as an adapter or wrapper around 'TreeBasedPolicyEnforcer', providing methods to check permissions and retrieve subjects with specific permissions.

classes.name: TreeBasedPolicyAlgorithm
classes.description: Implements PolicyAlgorithm, serving as an adapter to enforce policies and check permissions using a tree-based enforcer.

methods.name: TreeBasedPolicyAlgorithm
methods.description: Constructor initializing the policy evaluator with a given policy.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the specified resource and permissions are unrestricted for the given authorization context.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subject IDs that have the specified permission on the given resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subjects which have the specified permission on the resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Gets subject IDs with partial permissions on the resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Gets subjects with partial permissions on the resource.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the resource context has partial permissions for the specified permission.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JSON view of the resource based on JSON fields, authorization context, and permissions.
